rule: Officially mapped EFFIS burned areas in North Macedonia (layer ms:modis.ba.poly.<year>, COUNTRY = MK), chosen for size (including the largest of 2016, 2022 and 2023), clear multi-day satellite-detection coverage in the ApexFire archive, and spread over years and regions. Brvenica 2017 and the September 2024 Mariovo/Prilep event (EFFIS 240660) already have stories and are excluded.

stories.title: Saraj fire, summer 2017
stories.reason: Skopje region; burned at the same time as Brvenica, 112 detections over nine days.

stories.title: Makedonski Brod fire, September 2019
stories.reason: Largest mapped 2019 fire; south-west forest country, seen by MODIS and both VIIRS satellites (140 detections).

stories.title: Pehčevo fire, August 2021
stories.reason: Largest fire of the August 2021 heatwave (5,413 ha); eastern mountains, 645 detections.

context.text: On 4 August 2021 a squadron of five firefighting helicopters sent to the Pehčevo region was ordered to pull back because of extreme heat; MIA reported the fire spreading from Pehčevo toward Berovo.

stories.title: Kumanovo fire, August 2021
stories.reason: North-east region, same heatwave as Pehčevo: a short, intense contrast (115 detections in four days).

stories.title: Štip fire, July 2024
stories.reason: Largest mapped North Macedonia fire in the EFFIS layers checked (13,335 ha); seen by four sensors on seventeen days.

context.text: On the night of 13 July 2024 North Macedonia's parliament declared a 30-day nationwide crisis situation because of the rising number of wildfires in the central and eastern parts of the country.

stories.title: Sveti Nikole fire, July 2024
stories.reason: Vardar region, 12,051 ha; the densest detection coverage of the set (1,109 detections in six days).

stories.title: Novaci fire, August 2024
stories.reason: Pelagonia, 11,224 ha in August 2024: an earlier, separate event from the September Mariovo story.

stories.title: Vasilevo fire, July 2025
stories.reason: Largest mapped 2025 fire (5,227 ha); south-east region, detections on fifteen days.

stories.title: Češinovo fire, August 2016
stories.reason: Largest North Macedonia fire in the EFFIS 2016 layer (1,789 ha); east, Kočani valley.

stories.title: Negotino fire, July 2022
stories.reason: Largest North Macedonia fire in the EFFIS 2022 layer (587 ha), a mild year; Vardar region.

stories.title: Prilep fire, September 2023
stories.reason: Largest North Macedonia fire in the EFFIS 2023 layer (1,259 ha); Pelagonia, a late-season fire.

stories.title: Mogila fire, September 2023
stories.reason: Second-largest North Macedonia fire in the EFFIS 2023 layer (1,214 ha); Pelagonia; added for better detection coverage than Prilep 2023.
